import java.util.function.LongBinaryOperator;

public class B {
    static PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

    private static final LongBinaryOperator SOLVE = (r, c) -> {
        if (r < 3 && c < 3) return 0L;
        if (r == 1) return oneRow(c);
        if (r == 2) return twoRows(c);
        return (r * c) & ~1L;

        long C = in.nextLong();

    private static long oneRow(long c) {
        long m = c % 6;
        if (m == 0) return c;
        if (m <= 3) return c - m;
        if (m == 4) return c - 2;
        return c - 1;
    }

    private static long twoRows(long c) {
        if (c == 3 || c == 7) return 2L * (c - 1);
        return 2L * c;
    }
